meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: Claude 会给 HyperFrames 视频片段做关键帧动画:推近拉远、缩放、重构画面、Ken Burns 运镜,用 GSAP、CSS 等写出可定位(seek-safe)的 2D/3D 关键帧,再用命令行工具校验画面。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近拉远、缩放、运镜等关键帧,或要用 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 实现时触发;不负责整体场景策略、品牌设计、素材选取等。

say.text: 给这个 HyperFrames 片段加一个从全景推近到人物特写的缩放关键帧
say.note: 会写 seek-safe 关键帧并用 --shot 校验

say.text: 把这段镜头的画面重构一下,做缓慢的 Ken Burns 平移加缩放
say.note: 运镜是手动设定的几何动画,不追踪人脸

say.text: 用 GSAP 时间轴把这三个状态做成带缓动的位姿阶梯
say.note: 按状态标签编排,各段单独设缓动

howto.what_en: Claude animates HyperFrames clips with seek-safe keyframes: punch-ins, zooms, reframes and Ken Burns camera moves, authored in GSAP, CSS, Anime.js or WAAPI and verified with the hyperframes CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-ins, zooms or camera moves, or when keyframes are authored in GSAP, CSS or Anime.js. Not for scene strategy, brand design or media sourcing.

say_en.text: Add a zoom keyframe pushing from the wide shot to the subject's close-up
say_en.note: Claude writes seek-safe keyframes and verifies with --shot

say_en.text: Reframe this shot with a slow Ken Burns pan plus scale
say_en.note: Geometry is authored; no face tracking or auto reframing

say_en.text: Use a GSAP timeline to build these three states as a pose ladder with easing
say_en.note: States get labels; each segment has its own easing
